note: Synthetic cases only. Technical thresholds are disjoint from marketplace quotas (3 open requests, 6 activations/24h, 10 submissions/24h). No bypass path is specified in any configuration.

cases.scenario: Challenge request accepted by the provider adapter.
cases.expectation: Account stays pending; no session issued. Only a provider-confirmed code activates (INV-04).

cases.scenario: Registration or phone change targets a number held by a non-deleted account.
cases.expectation: Refused with a generic response plus a recovery/review offer; no other owner's history revealed (INV-07, AC-03, EC-22).

cases.scenario: Requests forge X-User-Id, role payloads, predictable tokens, or a universal fake code.
cases.expectation: No such mechanism exists. All are unauthenticated or refused; sessions derive only from server-side digest comparison.

cases.scenario: Pending, suspended, banned, or deleted session attempts publish, offer, or contact.
cases.expectation: Refused under current server state (INV-04). Only explicitly allowed safety/account-management actions proceed.

cases.scenario: Authenticated non-owner (any declared role) acts on another account's resource.
cases.expectation: Refused: role labels never replace ownership, state, or block checks (INV-05).

cases.scenario: A newly assigned subscriber's number matches a deleted account's history.
cases.expectation: Reviewed handling only; the new subscriber cannot inspect the previous owner's records (EC-22).

cases.scenario: Production configuration selects the deterministic fake provider.
cases.expectation: Startup refused. Missing live credentials block live certification only, never deterministic local construction.
